summary: All three artifact digests matched. I traced every plan acceptance criterion to executing evidence and found no claim of completed two-phase scope contradicted by measured results or implementation: the format string gnd-growth-view-v1 is emitted at src/gnd/model_verbalization.py:623; the strictly-smaller-with-three-counts criterion is asserted in tests/test_growth_projection.py (16,927-byte source fixture confirmed on disk, matching the close delta); empty models, unresolved-include refusal, guarded/anchored signatures, family-coverage growth failure, evidence-sentinel exclusion, and shared-player role retention (employee_reports_to_employee) all have tests; GC2's stale-include, evidence-only-edit raw-root divergence, role-direction, miss/retry/defer example, and nonfinite-metadata repairs map to named tests in tests/test_growth_view.py; the 497-byte CLI/API wheel parity, 229 byte-identical fixture pairs, and the eight documented commands (README shows validate x2, preview x2, apply x2, population check, judgments check, matching the close delta's category list) are consistent across the GC2 record and close delta; docs/reference/cli.md and docs/reference/python-api.md document the flag and keyword; all eight pinned evidence sha256 values in the GC2 record verify against the working tree. I could not construct a reproducible missed acceptance criterion, and optional extensions (search indexes, ranking, empirical recall, schema registry, prescribed search algorithm, second mutation API, release/merge) are correctly excluded in both plan section 7 and the close-delta residuals, with the focused-lane limitation disclosed in both records.
